_comment: Weapons' pair in P9: Comms asks a hostile contact to surrender. The chance rises with the contact's engine damage (base 0.1, up to 0.8 more, at most 0.9); a yes sets the faction's intent for it to surrendering, a no to hostile. Comms may ask again. The answer itself, we surrender or never, is the scenario's beat (scenarios/enemy_wave.gd), said when the roll lands.
